summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Itau Unibanco Holding S.A., a Brazilian foreign private issuer, disclosing the final detailed voting map of its Annual General Stockholders' Meeting held on April 28, 2026. The filing merely reports on the consolidation of remote voting instructions and votes cast during the meeting. It does not announce any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is a standard ongoing reporting obligation under the 1934 Act, equivalent to a US domestic company's 8-K filing of shareholder meeting results.
